$comment: G-206 — the gates every worktree-isolated background task in this repo must pass before Her
will report it green. Read from this file at spawn time, before the worker starts; the copy
inside a task's own worktree is never consulted, so a worker cannot edit its way to a pass.
Constraint that shapes this list: a task worktree is a fresh `git worktree add`, so it has no
node_modules. Only tests that import node builtins and local .ts files can run there (Node 24
strips the types natively). That is why this is the 'no-install' subset rather than the whole
suite, and why the gate name says so — a green here means the dependency-free suite passed,
A task that touches anything outside this subset should carry its own targeted `gates` on the
spawn call; those replace this default entirely.
